title: Symplecto-rigidity and bootstrap for Anosov symplectomorphisms and contact Anosov flows
summary: This paper is a sequel to the authors' paper on rigidity of higher dimensional contact Anosov flows~[GRH]. At the time the authors were unaware of much earlier work of Hamenstädt~[Ham] devoted to the same problem. The methods of~[GRH] and~[Ham] are overlapping but not entirely the same. In this paper we strengthen some the results of Hamenstädt, by further bootstrapping the regularity of the conjugacy of 2-pinched contact Anosov flows.
